doc.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022

title: Life on the road with Darin, Vegas and the Copacabana
summary: He disliked touring but enjoyed location gigs; the Copa and the Goodfellas scene.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you like being on the road?
That’s a good question, man. Not particularly. I liked, like when we had some location gigs like in Vegas, we were like maybe two, three weeks.
Or in New York at the Copa, we worked there a lot. That was nice because I got to see my brother you know. And actually I saw my wife there. I didn’t meet her there but I did see her.
That scene in Goodfellas where they walk in.
Oh, that’s it. That’s it man. Remember that kitchen? That whole scene. There was a waiter in that scene, he’s a real — I remember seeing that guy there.
Yeah, yeah. I remember that guy, seeing him all the time. Because we were there maybe three, four times a year you know. Because Bobby was hot then.
